description: Whole, pink and unpleasantly warm. Palehusk carries spares, which explains a great deal about Palehusk.
lore: Thirty-five gold is most of a week, and it comes out of the head, and the head is the last thing you do. There is a woman on the black-rock circuit who brings in four or five a season and is entirely plain about it: feet first, work upward, bag open on the stone and not in your lap. She says releasing at the counter and [[lore/the_hard_pieces|the other word]] at the fire, and means both. Warm is not the same as occupied, she says. Holding that difference is the whole of the job, and anybody who cannot hold it should go and do something else, with her blessing, today.

She keeps one rule that has nothing to do with the work. When it is [[monsters/malformed_creature|one of the person-shaped ones]], she closes the hand first — folds the open fingers over, before she starts on anything else. It does nothing for the shape. It is not for the shape.
gm_notes: The batch's centrepiece: both of the trade's words, used by one person who has earned each. She is not haunted and not hardened. The closed hand is the whole character in one gesture; never explain it further at the table.
